company.name: Velo3D
company.shortDescription: Velo3D is a digital manufacturing company that uses 3D production printers and flow print preparation software to print 3D metal.
company.description: Velo3D is a digital manufacturing company using a Sapphire 3D production printer and flow print preparation software to print 3D metals. Bringing together an integrated solution of software, hardware, and process-control innovation, Velo3D introduced the first SupportFree capability for 3D metal printing. This enables unlimited design innovation by reducing the need for support structures in metal additive manufacturing. The company’s Sapphire system is built with a semiconductor mindset on quality assurance, ensuring repeatability and dependability throughout serial manufacturing.

productsAndServices.description: Laser powder bed fusion printers for producing complex metal parts from qualified alloys, including titanium, nickel-based superalloys, aluminum, copper, and steel.
productsAndServices.name: Sapphire Metal AM Printers

productsAndServices.description: Large-format, multi-laser metal 3D printers for production-scale manufacturing of large or high-volume parts, with build volumes up to 600 mm in diameter by 1,000 mm in height.
productsAndServices.name: Sapphire XC Metal AM Printers

productsAndServices.description: Software for preparing metal additive manufacturing builds by importing CAD, arranging parts, assigning parameters, simulating thermal behavior, and inspecting print instructions.
productsAndServices.name: Flow Print Preparation Software

productsAndServices.description: Quality-control software that monitors machine health and part integrity, detects build anomalies in real time, and generates traceability and build-performance reports.
productsAndServices.name: Assure Quality Control Software

productsAndServices.description: A metal additive manufacturing service that produces customer parts from first article through production, including design-for-additive-manufacturing support, process control, and quality monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Rapid Production Solutions

productsAndServices.description: A network of qualified manufacturing partners that provides additional Velo3D production capacity and enables consistent part production across multiple sites using standardized digital print files.
productsAndServices.name: Manufacturing Network

aiResearchSummary.text: Velo3D is researching and developing three-dimensional printing systems, apparatuses, software, and methods for producing 3D objects, as described in titles such as 'Material manipulation in three-dimensional printing' and 'Accurate three-dimensional printing.' Abstracts highlight innovations in material conveyance, optical component calibration, real-time object detection, and gas flow control. Their work spans precise object formation, material handling, and system integration for additive manufacturing.
